content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"review","note":"The Agency's conclusion that Complainant failed to prove discrimination is linked to stated gaps (no corroboration, no affidavit, unspecified timing), but the path to the finding that management 'took whatever action it could' is not traceable because the record never shows what actions management took."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Many characterizations are tied to ROI pages (e.g., ROI at 8-11, 116, 130), but the Agency's findings on cohabitation, lack of corroboration, and management's actions have no cited source, and the Lead Manager's claim that both parties were separated is unsupported by any other source."},"rc3":{"status":"gap","note":"Key dates are missing or conflicting: harassment is said to run 'since March 2017,' the PS-13 was given in October 2018, the interview was August 7, 2018, and discussions of private information are on 'unspecified dates,' so there is no dated sequence of when management was told, when the parties were separated, or whether anything followed the PS-13."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who made the Agency's decision or what anti-harassment policy standard or threshold was applied, and it does not show whether management inquired into the PS-13, interviewed C1 or the coworkers, or considered Complainant's account before finalizing."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because the sequence, the decision-maker, and any management response are not documented, and the affidavit is absent, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record alone whether the conclusion on the harassment claim is supported."}}}
